# Affordance surfaces

Binding parity was captured, then widget parity, and the word
"parity" quietly came to mean the thin interface shell those two
cover. Kenshi's content database — larger than every captured surface
combined — went unmentioned for a whole session because no artefact had
a row for it. An absent surface reads exactly like a covered one.

This inventory is hand-authored, and unavoidably so: nothing Kenshi
ships enumerates its own surfaces. The defence is visibility, not
automation. `unexamined` is printed beside `captured`, and a surface
may not report a size it has not measured.

```text
surfaces            5
  captured          2
  source known      1
  UNEXAMINED        1
  not enumerable    1

game_binding  [captured]  enumerated: 72
    Named controls a player can press.
    source: data/../controls.cfg, captured to game_sources/kenshi/controls.cfg
    note: Enumerated is not usable: 71 are expressible by an action and 10 have an observable completion terminal. See GAME_BINDING_PARITY.

ui_widget  [captured]  enumerated: 563
    Named widgets in every window the game ships.
    source: data/gui/layout/*.layout, captured to game_sources/kenshi/gui_layout_widgets.tsv
    note: Denominator captured; reachability is unmeasured. Only four of 52 windows have been observed live. Excludes mod UI and widgets built in code rather than loaded from a layout.

world_context_action  [source_identified]  enumerated: —
    Orders a player can give a world object by right-click.
    source: KenshiLib `enum TaskType` (290 members), filtered at runtime by `PlayerInterface::isOrderValidForSelection`, with the exact per-target list in `ContextMenu::orders`.
    note: Nothing captured. Today's export is typed around one kind: `NaturalResourceTargetSnapshot`, hard-coded to natural_resource.

game_content  [unexamined]  enumerated: —
    The things acted upon: items, buildings, research, factions, dialogue, towns.
    source: data/gamedata.base (4.4 MB), data/Dialogue.mod (11.3 MB), data/Newwworld.mod (1.9 MB); reachable through FCS_extended, or as live game objects through KenshiLib.
    note: Larger than every captured surface combined and unexamined. `purchase_item` is a finished action with no enumeration of what is purchasable; `harvest_resource` works on Iron because a person reviewed Iron. Needed as a vocabulary for reasoning about what is encountered, NOT as a payload to preload into an observation.

continuous_control  [not_enumerable]  enumerated: —
    Where to walk, how much to buy, which bearing, camera angle.
    source: No artefact enumerates these; they are chosen, not offered.
    note: Listed so its absence from coverage is a decision rather than an oversight.

```
